condition: statement-only master-specification semantic entailment, conditional on satisfiable candidate
population: Prespecified constructed certificate-labeled controls; labels are not independent natural-output validation; no human ratings used.
split: six distinct task/representation families, two train, two validation, two test; proof twins remain in their family
forecast: Exact forall f, AgentMaster f -> GoldMaster f conditional on exists f, AgentMaster f; independent imperative equivalence is excluded.
eligibility: Jointly inconsistent and statement-level forbidden-axiom controls have null label and abstention target; never ordinary negatives.
models: One selected existing cached open-weight model, no hosted or subscription forecasts; model_identity.json fixed before preflight.
prompt: prompts/judge.md; opaque id and family/split/label/certificates not passed; only statement field passed.
preflight: One explicit label-in-prompt 0.375 reproduction call; no scientific outcome used for selection. Primary calls proceed only if parsed answer is exact.

fit.training: valid eligible training forecasts only; never validation/test in coefficient fitting
fit.selection: minimum matching validation loss for each fitted-loss family, ties within1e-12 choose strongest ridge; no optimizer success => constant0.5 fallback
fit.test: selection receipt written before test calls; no refitting after test

failures: All eligible rows retained. Invalid/missing/abstained raw and mapped forecasts use explicit0.5 fallback; constant uses training prevalence for every row. Also common-valid metrics, statuses, missing-loss best/worst bounds. Ineligible abstention separately scored.

uncertainty.p_value: n/a; constructed descriptive set, no population hypothesis test
uncertainty.warning: Only two test families; bootstrap cannot demonstrate broad generalization.

predictions.model_hypothesis: Valid output expected for all48; eligible Brier roughly0.12-0.25, log loss0.4-0.7, MAE0.2-0.4, absolute bias<=0.15, ordering0.4-0.8, AUROC0.7-0.9, accuracy/precision/recall0.7-0.9, kappa0.4-0.8; all uncertain hypotheses, not admission thresholds. Mean label0.5, mean forecast0.35-0.65. Ineligible abstention expected8-12 of12.
predictions.literal_compliance: Correct JSON alone gives valid output, not semantic correctness; literal exact oracle answers can attain zero Brier. No instruction asks for proof placeholders or operational search predictions.
predictions.degenerate: Always0.5 matches constant; always0 or1 has Brier0.5 and clipped logloss6.9078 on balanced eligible controls; empty/prose response invalid and explicit0.5 fallback.

bounds: CPU <=8threads and30minutes each analysis; primary jobs must finish before original supervisor deadline minus30minutes; reserved interrupted calls count and are never retried.
analysis_scope: Model-selection route chosen for feasible free execution, not validated judging quality. Natural-output expt169/171 and fresh human returns remain separate and unverified here.
